member.name: P:OmicronLab.Bode500.Engine.Bode500CommandDefinition.OmicronLab#BaseEngine#Engine#Interfaces#ICommandDefinition#SourceAttenuator
member.summary: Gets or sets the source attenuator. This is a bit-mask - see remarks for details.
member.remarks:
For the Bode 100 and the FRAnalyzer / FRANEO 800 the first 3 bit are used only: - SourceAttenuator[0] = HWConfig[9] -> S(source-0) -> SOURCE_5_DB. - SourceAttenuator[1] = HWConfig[9] -> S(source-1) -> SOURCE_10_DB. - SourceAttenuator[2] = HWConfig[9] -> S(source-2) -> SOURCE_20_DB.
For the Bode 500 the first 12 bits are used. - SourceAttenuator[0-5] = attenuator 1. - SourceAttenuator[6-11] = attenuator 2.
See implementation for details.

member.name: P:OmicronLab.Bode500.Engine.Bode500CommandDefinition.PathSwitchingDelayIndex
member.summary: Gets the index of the path-switching delay. If different between this index and the last index, the PathSwitchSettlingTime will be added before the actual measurement.

member.name: P:OmicronLab.Bode500.Engine.Bode500CommandDefinition.HardwareDelayIndex
member.summary: Gets the index of the hardware delay. If different between this index and the last index sent, a delay will be added before the actual measurement.
member.remarks: The hardware delay index is (mainly) needed when attenuator shaping will be done, because when switching the 20dB channel attenuators (CH1 and CH2) during a sweep measurement the involved HF relays need some settling time. The settling time is 0.5 milliseconds per relay which sums up to 1.0 milliseconds because two relays are affected.
